text.p: American Restaurant Partners LP said Thursday it declared a lower quarterly cash distribution of $0.11 per Class A income preference unit, payable January 31, record January 12.
The distribution is a $0.05 reduction from quarterly payments distributed in 1996.
American Restaurant, which operates 66 Pizza Hut restaurants, said the distribution represents about $200,000 less payout per quarter.

In a statement, chairman Hal McCoy said the partnership has fallen short of generating sufficient cash flow from operations to fund capital expenditures for recurring replacement of equipment in existing restaurants, to service debt obligations and to make quarterly cash distributions at an annual rate of $0.64 per Class A income preference unit.
